'''Nelchek''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was stationed at the [[Leth Outpost]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]].
